statement: Vast.ai marketplace GPU rental spot rates (per GPU/hr) as of 2026-07-01: H100 PCIe ~$0.90-$2.27 (host-tier dependent), H100 SXM ~$1.80-$2.50, H200 SXM ~$3.50-$5.50, B200 ~$6-$12 with very limited availability.
why: Marketplace spot rentals give a daily overlay on merchant-GPU rental economics, but rates are host-set with no stated baseline or change, so this is a static level.

impact.mechanism: Marketplace GPU rental spot-price level is a non-scoring display overlay for merchant-GPU rental economics, not a directional demand or supply signal.

evidence.excerpt: B200: verified datacenter ~$6-$12/hr range, availability 'very limited.'

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregator carrying Vast.ai marketplace rates; observation ~15 days old and host-variable.

dispersion: Wide host-tier dispersion: verified datacenter hosts price above unverified, e.g. H100 SXM ~$1.80-$2.50 vs H100 PCIe unverified ~$0.90-$1.60.
